stories.title: Salvadoran troops join Haiti gang operation that left 20 dead
stories.summary: Salvadoran troops backed a Haitian police operation against a gang that left about 20 people dead, ahead of the Haitian prime minister visit to El Salvador. It deepens San Salvador security role in the Caribbean nation.

stories.title: Republicans elect Jim Jordan as House minority leader
stories.summary: Ohio congressman Jim Jordan won a closed-door Republican vote to become House minority leader, succeeding Mike Johnson. He now leads the GOP opposition as the party adjusts to life in the minority.

stories.title: Violence erupts in Bangladesh as Hasina supporters protest
stories.summary: Supporters of ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina demonstrated to demand her return from exile in India, and the protests turned violent. Hasina has said she intends to come home in December.

stories.title: Rubio says no need for major combat operations against Iran
stories.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there is no need for further major combat operations against Iran, signaling Washington is leaning on diplomacy after weeks of strikes. Regional mediators are pushing to keep the ceasefire track alive.

stories.title: Anthropic founders to each sell about $250M in IPO
stories.summary: All seven Anthropic co-founders plan to sell identical share blocks worth roughly $250 million each at the midpoint of the IPO price range. The sales would still leave the founding group in control of the AI company.

stories.title: Nvidia hires Wachtell to investigate Huang affair
stories.summary: Nvidia retained law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen and Katz, with former US Attorney Joon Kim leading an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang relationship with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. The FBI is running its own probe.

stories.title: Oura to buy AI primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
stories.summary: Smart ring maker Oura agreed to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625 million. The deal comes weeks after Oura shelved its IPO plans, citing market uncertainty.

stories.title: OpenAI adds business profiles and agents to ChatGPT
stories.summary: OpenAI rolled out verified business profiles and AI business agents inside ChatGPT, pushing the chatbot toward product discovery and comparison shopping. The features put ChatGPT in more direct competition with Google search.

stories.title: Vikings trade for Kirk Cousins, removing a QB suitor
stories.summary: Minnesota sent a 2027 third-round pick to Las Vegas for Kirk Cousins hours before the NFL trade deadline. The move filled the Vikings quarterback need and took a potential landing spot for Shedeur Sanders off the board.

stories.title: Monken declines to name Browns starter for Texans game
stories.summary: Todd Monken said he was not ready to name either Deshaun Watson or Shedeur Sanders the starter for Sunday against Houston. Sanders threw for 297 yards and two touchdowns in the overtime loss at New Orleans.

stories.title: Analyst: Browns young playmakers raise quarterback urgency
stories.summary: Dan Labbe argues that breakout seasons from Cleveland young skill players make solving the quarterback position more urgent. He weighs Watson, Sanders and a 2027 draft pick as the paths forward.

stories.title: Day says he is frustrated but sticking with Fahey at QB
stories.summary: Ryan Day said he is extremely disappointed and frustrated with the Ohio State two-game slide and is evaluating his staff weekly. He confirmed Luke Fahey remains the starting quarterback against Northwestern.

stories.title: Rob Keys takes over Ohio State special teams after firing
stories.summary: Rob Keys, an analyst and quality control coach since 2022, will coordinate special teams for the rest of the 2026 season. The change follows the firing of coordinator Robby Discher.

stories.title: Sonny Styles to ring Victory Bell before Northwestern game
stories.summary: Former Ohio State linebacker Sonny Styles returns to Ohio Stadium to ring the Victory Bell on Saturday. He becomes the first active NFL player to ring it before a regular-season game.

stories.title: Chip Kelly brings high-scoring Northwestern offense to Columbus
stories.summary: Ohio State hosts a 6-3 Northwestern team running a Chip Kelly offense that has surprised the Big Ten. The status of quarterback Aidan Chiles is uncertain after he missed last week with an injury.

stories.title: Hamilton visits Rafah crossing on Gaza aid trip
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton toured the Egyptian side of the Rafah crossing and Egyptian Red Crescent warehouses, meeting aid workers. The North Sinai governor said the visit was a chance to see how supplies reach Gaza.

stories.title: Liberty Media founder John Malone sells F1 voting power
stories.summary: John Malone, the Liberty Media founder and former chairman, has sold his significant voting power in Formula 1 parent company. The sale reshapes influence over the sport commercial rights holder.

stories.title: Wolff: Antonelli is not Senna yet, but maybe a Senninha
stories.summary: Toto Wolff said comparisons between Kimi Antonelli and Ayrton Senna are premature but called his champion driver a Senninha, a little Senna. The remark came as Brazilian media search for the next great Brazilian driver.

stories.title: F1 drops Imola as fallback with Middle East finale in doubt
stories.summary: Formula 1 formally stood Imola down as a reserve venue, leaving Qatar on November 29 and Abu Dhabi on December 6 as the planned season finale. There is no backup plan if the Iran war escalates and the Gulf races cannot run.

stories.title: Tarkov players parse new UNTAR season teaser
stories.summary: Players on the Escape from Tarkov subreddit are dissecting a teaser video tagged UNTAR as Battlestate prepares to reveal the Season 2 theme. Season 2 is due in December and replaces the Kord Breach season.

stories.title: Jury convicts Pammy Maye in death of 5-year-old Darnell Taylor
stories.summary: A Franklin County jury found Pammy Maye guilty of aggravated murder, tampering with evidence and gross abuse of a corpse. The case stems from the 2024 death of Darnell Taylor, whose remains were found in a storm drain.

stories.title: Veterans Day 2026: what is open and closed around Columbus
stories.summary: Columbus area services shift for Veterans Day on Wednesday, including trash collection changes and free COTA rides for veterans. Most government offices and some businesses close for the holiday.

stories.title: Longtime Columbus Italian restaurant listed for sale
stories.summary: A longtime northeast Columbus Italian restaurant is up for sale as its owner looks for a successor. The listing adds to a wave of turnover among locally owned restaurants in the city.

stories.title: Woman struck by semi on I-71 near Polaris dies
stories.summary: A 25-year-old woman injured in a weekend rear-end collision on Interstate 71 near Polaris died Monday night, Columbus police said. The crash remains under investigation.
